language_rules.register: Formal academic and professional writing using Australian/British English (e.g. modernise, programme, organisation).
principles: Ensure every claim is backed by a specific detail from the fact sheet.
Prefer concrete facts over emotional claims.

banned_phrases: I will abide by all visa conditions
I promise to return to Bangladesh
I want to escape my country
this university was my only option
at the end of the day

preferred_replacements.I want PR: My goal is to build a professional career after completing the program.
preferred_replacements.better opportunities only: This program aligns with my academic and career development goals.
preferred_replacements.this university was my only option: This university best matches my academic interests and course requirements.

bangladesh_evidence_level_3_protocol.default_documentation_burden: Evidence Level 3 (Highest Scrutiny) assumed by default for Bangladesh applicants.
bangladesh_evidence_level_3_protocol.seasoning_scrutiny: Mandatory 3 to 6 months of bank statement history must be referenced in GS Response 2 and SOP Paragraph 7.
bangladesh_evidence_level_3_protocol.deposit_screening_question: Any large/irregular deposits in the last 6 months must be declared and documented for source of funds verification.
bangladesh_evidence_level_3_protocol.risk_neutralization_action: Treat evidence anchoring as mandatory for all claims (no undocumented assertions allowed).

red_flags: Institution or provider is not CRICOS registered
Any GS response exceeds the 150-word limit
Financial evidence is below the required AUD 29,710/yr benchmark plus dependent costs
Sudden large deposits without 3 to 6 months seasoning history
Missing relationship documents (birth/marriage certs) for sponsors
IELTS overall score below 6.0 or any band below 5.5
Study gap exceeding 6 months without documented explanation
Vague, generic, or lifestyle-focused career plans
Undisclosed prior visa refusals from any country
Large/irregular deposits in the last 6 months not explained with source verification
Lack of 3 to 6 months bank statement history language in GS Response 2 or SOP Paragraph 7
